embeds.title: 🟡 New Critical Exim Mailer Flaw Allows Remote Code Execution
embeds.description:
A critical user-after-free vulnerability (CVE-2026-45185) in Exim mail transfer agent versions 4.97 through 4.99.2 using GnuTLS allows unauthenticated remote attackers to execute arbitrary code by exploiting TLS shutdown handling during BDAT chunked SMTP traffic. The vulnerability was discovered by XBOW researcher Federico Kirschbaum and reported to Exim maintainers on May 1st, with a fix released in version 4.99.3.
**Sources:** BleepingComputer • 🔴 1 corroborating
**CVEs:** CVE-2026-45185 • **Access:** Network - SMTP/TLS

embeds.title: 🔴 Fortinet Fixes Two Critical RCE Flaws in FortiAuthenticator and FortiSandbox
embeds.description:
Fortinet released patches for two critical remote code execution vulnerabilities: CVE-2026-44277 in FortiAuthenticator (CVSS 9.1, improper access control allowing unauthenticated code execution) and CVE-2026-26083 in FortiSandbox (CVSS 9.1, missing authorization allowing unauthenticated arbitrary code execution). Both were discovered internally by Fortinet with no evidence of in-the-wild exploitation yet. The article notes that other Fortinet RCE vulnerabilities have been exploited in the wild historically, including CVE-2026-21643 and a FortiClient EMS zero-day.
**Sources:** CSO Online • 🔴 1 corroborating
**CVEs:** CVE-2026-44277, CVE-2026-26083, CVE-2026-21643, CVE-2025-53844, CVE-2025-53870, CVE-2025-53680 • **Access:** Network (HTTP requests for CVE-2026-26083; specifically crafted requests for CVE-2026-44277)
**Incident date:** unknown • **Confidence:** claim
[Read source](https://www.csoonline.com/article/4170993/fortinet-fixes-two-critical-rce-flaws-in-fortiauthenticator-and-fortisandbox.html)
